the-majorana-condition-3e26f95d.title: The Majorana Condition

hubble-parameter-definition-growth-fc511.title: Hubble Parameter (H)
hubble-parameter-definition-growth-fc511.interpretation: Quantifies the instantaneous fractional rate of expansion of the 4D manifold, serving as the definitive measurement of the cosmic 'Stretch' at any point in history.
hubble-parameter-definition-growth-fc511.symmetry_origin: The first derivative of the log-scale factor in a homogeneous and isotropic vacuum.
hubble-parameter-definition-growth-fc511.limits_and_boundary: In the limit of a constant expansion law (de Sitter space), H becomes a static value, selectioning a specific 4D causal topology for the universe's ultimate fate.
